title: Rescheduling a Delivery
text: A delivery can be rescheduled while the parcel is pending pickup or in transit. It cannot be rescheduled once it is out for delivery. A parcel can be rescheduled at most 2 times, and the new date must be within 7 days from today.

title: Late Delivery Compensation
text: If a parcel arrives more than 3 days after its promised date, the customer can file a LATE claim for up to 300 rupees. Delays of 3 days or less are not eligible for compensation.

title: Damaged Parcels
text: A damaged parcel must be reported within 48 hours of delivery. The customer can claim up to the declared value of the parcel. Every damage claim is reviewed by a human before payment.

title: Lost Parcels
text: A parcel with no scan for 7 days is treated as lost. The customer can claim up to the declared value of the parcel. Lost parcel claims are reviewed by a human before payment.

title: Claim Approval Limits
text: Claims of 500 rupees or less are approved automatically. Claims above 500 rupees and up to 5000 rupees need a reviewer. Claims above 5000 rupees need a senior reviewer. A claim can never exceed the declared value of the parcel.

title: Items We Do Not Carry
text: SwiftParcel does not carry loose batteries, liquids, flammable goods or cash. Such parcels are returned to the sender.

title: Changing the Delivery Address
text: The delivery address can be changed only before the parcel is dispatched. After dispatch the customer can reschedule the delivery but not change the address.

title: Customer Privacy
text: Support staff never share one customer's parcel details with another customer. Tracking details are shown only to the customer who owns the parcel.
